answer: The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own wharf record, and its own share of the ripple quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The zephyr ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1899 identities would post 4463 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
